sections.title: Headline
sections.content: AI coding-agent infrastructure dominates today's list: security-audit skills, code review agents, browser control, agent harnesses, and spec-driven workflows occupy most of the top positions.

sections.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
sections.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings.

sections.title: anthropics/claude-code
sections.description: An agentic coding tool that works in the terminal and executes routine development and Git workflows.

sections.title: alibaba/open-code-review
sections.description: A hybrid deterministic-pipeline and LLM-agent code-review tool.

sections.title: affaan-m/ECC
sections.description: An agent-harness optimization system covering skills, memory, security, and research-first development.

sections.title: Tencent/BrowserSkill
sections.description: CLI and extension tooling for agents using real logged-in browsers.

sections.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
sections.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.

sections.title: TencentCloud/Octop
sections.description: A self-hosted, multi-user, multi-agent AI assistant.

sections.title: Fission-AI/OpenSpec
sections.description: Spec-driven development for AI coding assistants.

sections.title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
sections.description: Open-source plugins for knowledge workers using Claude Cowork.

sections.title: supermemoryai/supermemory
sections.description: A fast, scalable memory and context engine that can run fully locally.

sections.title: tradesdontlie/tradingview-mcp
sections.description: AI-assisted TradingView chart analysis connecting Claude Code to TradingView Desktop.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agentic coding infrastructure, agent access to browsers and desktop tools, security and governance, memory and self-hosting. JavaScript/TypeScript dominate the listed repositories.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: The center of gravity is moving from standalone AI applications toward reusable skills, connectors, spec-driven execution, security checks, and memory.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today's momentum is concentrated in the layers that make agents dependable in real workflows: constrain, verify, remember, and connect them to existing software.
